reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "AlertmanagerConfig v1alpha1 schema: allowed values changed: `spec.receivers[].opsgenieConfigs[].responders[].type`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: Applying (creating or updating) an AlertmanagerConfig whose spec.receivers[].opsgenieConfigs[].responders[].type is not one of escalation, schedule, team, teams, user is rejected by the API server.
consequence.remediation: Set spec.receivers[].opsgenieConfigs[].responders[].type to one of the allowed values (escalation, schedule, team, teams, user) before applying or updating the resource.

proposed.statement: The monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1 schema of alertmanagerconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com now restricts spec.receivers[].opsgenieConfigs[].responders[].type to the enum values escalation, schedule, team, teams and user (no values were removed from a prior enum, but the field was previously unconstrained), so any other value is rejected by the API server.
